en.help_tooltip:
c_n's healer rabbits will gather herbs over each timeskip and during any patrols they are sent on. You can see what was gathered in the Log below! The healer rabbits will give these to any hurt or sick rabbits that need them, helping those rabbits to heal quicker.

Hover your mouse over the healer den image to see what herbs your Warren has!

meds_cover.many: c_n's healer rabbits can care for a Warren of up to %{clansize} members, including themselves.
